AddToCartRequest.title: Add To Cart Request
AddToCartRequest.description: Payload to add a product to the authenticated user's cart. Use product_variant_id (Mode 1) OR color_id/size_id (Mode 2).

product_variant_id.description: Mode 1: pass the variant ID directly

color_id.description: Mode 2: color ID, server resolves to variant

size_id.description: Mode 2: size ID, server resolves to variant

GuestCheckoutRequest.description: Payload for guest checkout. Backend re-calculates all prices from DB — never trust FE price/total.

color_id.description: Mode 2: resolve variant by color + size
